on_enter.code: local p = { beamStrength=0.82, beamWidth=0.82, beamDriveExpansion=1.25, signalSpread=1.65, lumaBleed=0.52, compositeBleed=1.20, chromaDelay=0.35, ghostStrength=0.08, bloomStrength=0.42, halationStrength=0.24, halationRadius=1.55, convergencePixels=0.0, grilleStrength=0.0, slotMaskStrength=0.0, curvature=0.0, vignette=0.06, noiseStrength=0.006 }; local mode = api.getOutputPresentation() or 'crt'; if string.sub(mode, 1, 4) == 'crt:' then for k, raw in string.gmatch(mode, '([%a][%w_]*)=([^;]+)') do if p[k] ~= nil then p[k] = tonumber(raw) or p[k] end end end; ctx.sceneState.crt = p

on_left.code: local order={'beamStrength','beamWidth','beamDriveExpansion','signalSpread','lumaBleed','compositeBleed','chromaDelay','ghostStrength','bloomStrength','halationStrength','halationRadius','convergencePixels','grilleStrength','slotMaskStrength','curvature','vignette','noiseStrength'}; local step={beamStrength=0.05,beamWidth=0.05,beamDriveExpansion=0.10,signalSpread=0.10,lumaBleed=0.05,compositeBleed=0.10,chromaDelay=0.10,ghostStrength=0.05,bloomStrength=0.10,halationStrength=0.10,halationRadius=0.10,convergencePixels=0.25,grilleStrength=0.05,slotMaskStrength=0.05,curvature=0.01,vignette=0.05,noiseStrength=0.01}; local lo={beamStrength=0,beamWidth=0.05,beamDriveExpansion=0,signalSpread=0.10,lumaBleed=0,compositeBleed=0,chromaDelay=-12,ghostStrength=0,bloomStrength=0,halationStrength=0,halationRadius=0.05,convergencePixels=-16,grilleStrength=0,slotMaskStrength=0,curvature=-0.60,vignette=-1,noiseStrength=0}; local hi={beamStrength=3,beamWidth=6,beamDriveExpansion=8,signalSpread=12,lumaBleed=5,compositeBleed=8,chromaDelay=12,ghostStrength=4,bloomStrength=6,halationStrength=6,halationRadius=12,convergencePixels=16,grilleStrength=3,slotMaskStrength=3,curvature=0.60,vignette=3,noiseStrength=1}; local id=order[ctx.sceneState.idx]; local p=ctx.sceneState.crt; p[id]=math.max(lo[id],math.min(hi[id],p[id]-step[id])); local parts={}; for _,k in ipairs(order) do table.insert(parts,k..'='..string.format('%.4g',p[k])) end; api.setOutputPresentation('crt:'..table.concat(parts,';'))

on_right.code: local order={'beamStrength','beamWidth','beamDriveExpansion','signalSpread','lumaBleed','compositeBleed','chromaDelay','ghostStrength','bloomStrength','halationStrength','halationRadius','convergencePixels','grilleStrength','slotMaskStrength','curvature','vignette','noiseStrength'}; local step={beamStrength=0.05,beamWidth=0.05,beamDriveExpansion=0.10,signalSpread=0.10,lumaBleed=0.05,compositeBleed=0.10,chromaDelay=0.10,ghostStrength=0.05,bloomStrength=0.10,halationStrength=0.10,halationRadius=0.10,convergencePixels=0.25,grilleStrength=0.05,slotMaskStrength=0.05,curvature=0.01,vignette=0.05,noiseStrength=0.01}; local lo={beamStrength=0,beamWidth=0.05,beamDriveExpansion=0,signalSpread=0.10,lumaBleed=0,compositeBleed=0,chromaDelay=-12,ghostStrength=0,bloomStrength=0,halationStrength=0,halationRadius=0.05,convergencePixels=-16,grilleStrength=0,slotMaskStrength=0,curvature=-0.60,vignette=-1,noiseStrength=0}; local hi={beamStrength=3,beamWidth=6,beamDriveExpansion=8,signalSpread=12,lumaBleed=5,compositeBleed=8,chromaDelay=12,ghostStrength=4,bloomStrength=6,halationStrength=6,halationRadius=12,convergencePixels=16,grilleStrength=3,slotMaskStrength=3,curvature=0.60,vignette=3,noiseStrength=1}; local id=order[ctx.sceneState.idx]; local p=ctx.sceneState.crt; p[id]=math.max(lo[id],math.min(hi[id],p[id]+step[id])); local parts={}; for _,k in ipairs(order) do table.insert(parts,k..'='..string.format('%.4g',p[k])) end; api.setOutputPresentation('crt:'..table.concat(parts,';'))

on_select.code: local order={'beamStrength','beamWidth','beamDriveExpansion','signalSpread','lumaBleed','compositeBleed','chromaDelay','ghostStrength','bloomStrength','halationStrength','halationRadius','convergencePixels','grilleStrength','slotMaskStrength','curvature','vignette','noiseStrength'}; local def={beamStrength=0.82,beamWidth=0.82,beamDriveExpansion=1.25,signalSpread=1.65,lumaBleed=0.52,compositeBleed=1.20,chromaDelay=0.35,ghostStrength=0.08,bloomStrength=0.42,halationStrength=0.24,halationRadius=1.55,convergencePixels=0.0,grilleStrength=0.0,slotMaskStrength=0.0,curvature=0.0,vignette=0.06,noiseStrength=0.006}; local id=order[ctx.sceneState.idx]; local p=ctx.sceneState.crt; p[id]=def[id]; local parts={}; for _,k in ipairs(order) do table.insert(parts,k..'='..string.format('%.4g',p[k])) end; api.setOutputPresentation('crt:'..table.concat(parts,';'))

crtParams.name: BEAM MIX
crtParams.help: How strongly the Gaussian beam reconstruction replaces ordinary vertical interpolation. 1 is already strong; values above 1 deliberately overdrive it.

crtParams.name: BEAM WIDTH
crtParams.help: Vertical phosphor spot width in native source-row units. High values make adjacent scanlines melt into one another.

crtParams.name: DRIVE EXPANSION
crtParams.help: How much bright pixels widen the beam. Extreme values make highlights swell far more than dark detail.

crtParams.name: SIGNAL SPREAD
crtParams.help: Horizontal source-pixel distance sampled by the analogue bandwidth filter. Large values destroy fine colour detail aggressively.

crtParams.name: LUMA BLEED
crtParams.help: Low-pass filtering of brightness at native resolution. Values above 1 extrapolate beyond the filtered signal instead of stopping at a realistic blend.

crtParams.name: CHROMA BLEED
crtParams.help: YIQ chroma bandwidth loss. This is the colour degradation control; the range intentionally goes far beyond plausible composite video.

crtParams.name: CHROMA DELAY
crtParams.help: Horizontal chroma timing error in native pixels. Negative values reverse the direction; huge values can separate colour from structure.

crtParams.name: GHOST
crtParams.help: Delayed bright-signal echo. At high values it stops being subtle RF damage and becomes a visible duplicate.

crtParams.name: BLOOM
crtParams.help: Neutral highlight energy spread sampled from neighbouring source positions. The upper range is intentionally destructive.

crtParams.name: HALATION
crtParams.help: Warm glass-like highlight spread, independent of neutral bloom.

crtParams.name: HALO RADIUS
crtParams.help: Source-pixel radius used by bloom and halation. Large values pull light from distant image structure.

crtParams.name: CONVERGENCE
crtParams.help: Red/blue registration drift in physical output pixels. Negative values swap the direction.

crtParams.name: APERTURE GRILLE
crtParams.help: Physical RGB stripe mask strength. Values above 1 intentionally over-modulate channel brightness.

crtParams.name: SLOT MASK
crtParams.help: Staggered RGB slot-mask strength. It can be combined with the aperture grille for deliberately implausible patterns.

crtParams.name: CURVATURE
crtParams.help: Barrel curvature. Negative values bend the opposite way; the range extends well beyond a believable tube.

crtParams.name: VIGNETTE
crtParams.help: Edge darkening. Negative values brighten the edges instead, while high positive values can crush them entirely.

crtParams.name: NOISE
crtParams.help: Host-pixel multiplicative noise. The maximum is intentionally much stronger than useful television noise.
